The structure of Dy₂C₂ (reduced formula DyC) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with four atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows carbon centers coordinated by three Dy neighbors at 2.2262 Å, while Dy centers have nine geometric neighbors (six C and three Dy), with neighbor distances ranging from 2.2262 to 3.2418 Å. The resulting periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all four sites. Validated polyhedron contacts indicate that 9-vertex Dy coordination polyhedra share edges, and 3-vertex C polyhedra share corners and edges.
